title: The loop, reviewed: the turn and the loop point
description: The last 8 seconds of each video running into its first 8, so the loop’s cut is at the middle (8 s), with the sound exact to the sample. Picture: past the widest view everything drawn is the opening’s, so the last frame is the first. Sound: on five songs, today’s loop point against the song ending as cut.

passages.description: Passo Bem Solto: today the video ends 0.61 s early, where the music is in step with what leads into its start (match 0.90); “Ending as cut” is the same with the song ending where the excerpt was cut, as yesterday. The cut is at 8 s.
